subject.title: feat(discord): add canvas-first Discord Activities support

question: Should Discord Activities be reworked through the current Canvas plugin contract with credentialed Activity auth, or should maintainers explicitly accept a new core/root-config Activity surface and its security model?
rationale: The patch crosses Canvas plugin ownership, Gateway auth bypass, token transport, third-party script execution, and A2UI fanout limits; automation cannot choose that boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Rework through Canvas plugin
options.body: Move Activity config/routing into the Canvas plugin contract and harden auth, SDK loading, and fanout before reconsidering merge.

options.title: Accept a core exception
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally sponsor root/core Activity config, but that should come with explicit security sign-off and upgrade proof.

options.title: Replace with a clean branch
options.body: If the stale base is too far from current main, close or pause this branch and ask for a narrow replacement on the plugin-owned Canvas architecture.

recommendation.title: Rework through Canvas plugin
recommendation.body: Move Activity config/routing into the Canvas plugin contract and harden auth, SDK loading, and fanout before reconsidering merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Andy Ye introduced the current Canvas plugin config and HTTP route ownership that governs the main product boundary at issue.
